bans.label: City of Fairhope Safe Streets plan: LSVs may not travel along Greeno Road (US 98), including shoulders and side paths. Crossings at Fairhope Avenue and Morphy Avenue are the named exceptions.

unverified: The plan names crossings of Greeno Road at Fairhope Avenue and Morphy Avenue. The road itself stays red, including short pieces, because the ban is explicit.
sources: City of Fairhope Safe Streets plan https://www.fairhopeal.gov/DocumentCenter/View/601/Fairhopesap-Final-Safe-Roads-Web-PDF

sources.label: City of Fairhope Safe Streets plan

enforcement.note: Posted signs do not lift a ban. A designated street list that is not digitized stays red for plain golf carts.
